name: d-Matrix Corsair Redefines Performance and Efficiency for AI Inference at Scale (white paper)
notes: Per single PCIe card: 2 GB Performance Memory at 150 TB/s (150,000 GB/s) plus up to 256 GB LPDDR5 capacity memory. memory_gb records the high-bandwidth tier only. Dual-card config: 4 GB at 300 TB/s; 8-card server: 16 GB at 1200 TB/s with up to 2 TB capacity memory.
